sections.title: The letter Eszett
paragraphs: The letter is named (Eszett) /ɛsˈtsɛt/. It makes a sharp hissing sound. You hear it in (Straße) /ˈʃtʁaːsə/, which means street. This letter makes only one sound. It always sounds clear and crisp.

sections.title: Making the sound
paragraphs: Place the tip of your tongue near the ridge behind your upper teeth. Leave a very tiny gap. Blow air through this gap to create a sharp hiss. Keep your vocal cords still. Touch your throat with your fingers and feel no buzz at all.

sections.title: Reading the letter
paragraphs: This letter always stands after a long vowel or two vowel sounds together. It always sounds like the voiceless hiss in (groß) /ɡʁoːs/. You also hear this exact sound after a glide in (fleißig) /ˈflaɪ̯sɪç/.

sections.title: Avoiding mistakes
paragraphs: Do not turn this letter into a buzzing sound like the sound in rose. Keep your voice completely off. Make it a pure hiss, exactly like the voiceless sound in the English word mass.
